diffs.diff: magnetic field (gauss): datasheet reading gives 0.00014 per count, the part's model has 0.0625, 0.00875, 0.00875, 0.00875, 0.000061, 0.000061, 0.000061
diffs.evidence: LSM9DS1 datasheet Table 3 (mechanical characteristics): 'M_GN Magnetic sensitivity, Magnetic FS = ±4 gauss 0.14 mgauss/LSB' (0.29/0.43/0.58 at ±8/12/16 gauss). The model already uses exactly this: the magnetometer is a separate I2C device at 0x1E modelled in sim.subDevices[0], whose measures at 0x28/0x2A/0x2C (mx/my/mz) all have scale 0.00014 gauss/count, and the driver's _MAG_FS[4] = 0.14e-3 gauss/LSB (default mag_fs=4, CTRL_REG2_M FS=00). The values listed by the gate (0.0625 temperature, 0.00875 gyro, 0.000061 accel) are the top-level accel/gyro device's measures at 0x6B, not the magnetometer; the gate did not look into subDevices.
